copy.description: This bias-cut dress features a slim fit and thin adjustable straps that fall to midi length. The ivory silk is smooth and drapes cleanly over the body without excess fabric. It maintains a measured silhouette from shoulder to hem with minimal structure. Worn alone for evening events or ceremonies, it offers a quiet presence suitable for spring and summer. The garment requires no embellishment to command attention in its simplicity.

Les bretelles ajustables sont fines, tandis que la longueur midi reste sobre. Elle se porte pour un dîner ou une cérémonie en été. Le tissu léger assure une tenue soignée toute la journée.

copy.title: Tailored Wool Trousers in Charcoal
copy.description: These charcoal trousers feature a flat front with a pressed crease that holds its shape. Made from virgin wool, they offer a slim fit that moves cleanly with the body. Side pockets sit discreetly at the hip without adding bulk to the leg line. The fabric is responsibly sourced wool (RWS certified) for enduring quality through autumn and winter. They are worn alone or under a coat during work hours when precision matters most.

copy.title: Pantaloni in Lana Grigio Antracite
copy.description: Un taglio slim con davanti piatto e piegatura pressata che definisce la linea della gamba. La lana virgin mantiene una superficie liscia senza eccessi di volume, lasciando spazio al movimento. I tasconi laterali sono semplici e integrati nel tessuto senza risalti visivi. Perfetti per il lavoro in autunno o inverno, si abbinano con camicie classiche o giacche strutturate.

copy.title: Trousers en laine charbon
copy.description: Des pantalons de coupe slim dans un gris anthracite uni. La matière en laine vierge offre une silhouette soignée et mesurée. Une ceinture plate maintient une ligne nette avec une passe de repassage visible. Les poches latérales sont discrètes, sans ornement ni décor excessif. Ils s'adaptent aux environnements professionnels tout au long des saisons automne et hiver.

copy.title: White Poplin Shirt
copy.description: A white shirt with a semi-spread collar and mother-of-pearl buttons. The organic cotton fabric offers a smooth surface that stays orderly throughout the day. Its regular fit allows for movement without losing its clean lines. It is worn at work or in casual settings from morning until evening. This piece remains appropriate across all seasons.

copy.title: Camicia Poplin Bianca

La vestibilità misurata si adatta alla silhouette senza appesantire il look. Si porta al lavoro o in occasioni casual durante tutte le stagioni.

copy.title: Chemise en coton bio blanc

La texture reste soignée lors d'un port quotidien ou professionnel. Elle se porte seule pour le travail ou décontractée en occasion informelle. Cette pièce s'adapte à toutes les saisons grâce à sa matière légère.
